use: Historical development. Keep all tiles of one incident in the same split.
datum: USGS 3DEP in the continental US and STN marks in NAVD88. Never subtract a NOAA MLLW peak from this terrain.
seasonal_mask_limitation: The 1984–2021 water mask uses later observations for some incidents. This is a retrospective reference filter only.
method: Only the mark-containing 30 m UTM cell qualifies. Require mark within half a pixel (15 m) of its centre, JRC occurrence below 80% with a valid water-history observation, and peak height above local 10 m terrain by more than 1 m plus the available survey margin (at least 0.2 ft). The 1 m guard is a conservative engineering allowance for DEM and point-to-pixel mismatch. It is not a validated error bound. Multiple different supported states in the same cell abstain.
scope: A wet cell contains evidence of inundation close to its centre. The survey supplies neither the flooded fraction nor a causal type. A survey documenting a physical trace days later can still capture the peak. It does not date the land surface in a later aerial photograph.
survey_rights: The underlying USGS federal field observations are public-domain US government data. The ArcGIS mirrors list no additional explicit licence. Attribute USGS, the named mirror, and the EC JRC/Google water data. Treat the Rutgers Manville repackaging as research-only pending confirmation of reuse terms.

Sally.finding: NHC and SallyTCRData provide rounded station or survey positions. A location rounded to 0.01 degree cannot select a 30 m cell.

Laura.finding: NWS mapped NAVD elevations and NHC reported surveyed points. The cartographic point positions and rounded NHC coordinates could not be verified to 30 m.
